title: Trump Administration Alters CDC Methodology for Counting Measles Deaths Amid Pennsylvania Outbreak
detail: The Trump administration changed the CDC's methodology for counting measles deaths during the ongoing Pennsylvania outbreak, raising significant transparency and public health accountability concerns. The change affects how federal officials tally measles-related fatalities, with implications for understanding the true toll of the 2026 outbreak. Critics argue the revised counting method obscures the scale of the crisis.

media.caption: CDC measles death counting methodology changed by Trump administration amid Pennsylvania outbreak
